    Stable bricks from nonpresilting presentations #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.exists_stable_image_of_not_isPresilting (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsArtinianRing R] (P : TwoTerm R) (hP : ¬P.IsPresilting) :
    ∃ (f : CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel P.differential ⟶ nakayamaKernel k P), f ≠ 0 ∧ IsBrick (CategoryTheory.Limits.image f) ∧ ((eulerWeight k P).corrected (dimensionWeight k) (CategoryTheory.Limits.image f)).IsStable (CategoryTheory.Limits.image f)

    A nonpresilting differential gives a stable brick by correcting its Euler weight using the dimension of the image over the ground field.
